note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a Const 142(1), Act no. 370  40, 41, Supreme Decree no. 1923 20; A06b Const 142(1), Act no. 370  40, 41, Supreme Decree no. 1923 20; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 3 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.
